interserver.label: Cross-server
interserver.description: Links channels from different servers: a message posted in a linked channel is relayed (name + avatar preserved) to the other channels of the same network.

g0.description: Channels are linked with the “Link / Unlink a channel” actions below.

tagServer.label: Show the origin server's name on relayed messages
tagServer.help: Appends « • ServerName » to the nickname shown on every relayed message. Keep it on as soon as the network links more than two servers: without it, two members sharing a nickname become indistinguishable, and you no longer know where what you read comes from.

link.label: Link a channel
link.help: Servers sharing the same network code have their messages relayed to each other.

network.label: Network code
network.help: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits and hyphens.

msg.badChannel: Channel not found or not a text channel.
msg.noPermission: The “Manage Webhooks” permission is missing on this channel.

unlink.label: Unlink a channel
unlink.confirm: Remove this channel from its cross-server network?

msg.pickChannel: Pick a channel that is currently linked.
